spec.problem_statement: In src/components/MetricsDashboard.tsx, the 'Documents by Category' chart inside renderDocumentMetrics() is commented out, leaving reviewers with an empty Card that has a header but no content and no explanation. This makes the Documents tab look broken or incomplete when reviewers check category breakdown. Done means the card either renders the pie chart from documentMetrics.documentsByCategory or, if that data is unavailable, shows a clear empty-state message instead of a blank body.
